view.zoom.zoom.note: U:prism/view: the Zoom dialog (dialog.zoom); the arrow lists the percents and Fit.

view.color.color.note: U:prism/view: draw the slides in full color (view.color); on while Grayscale is off.

view.color.grayscale.note: U:prism/view: draw the slides in grays (view.grayscale).

view.color.dark-mode.note: Hidden: deckcraft's Dark Mode switches the app's own light and dark theme; the app has one skin.

view.window.arrange-all.note: U:prism/view: the open windows stacked one above the other (host windows).

view.window.switch.note: U:prism/view: the open windows in the order they were opened, the current one checked; a click brings that window to the front.
